response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM j), pairs AS (SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr, ABS(AVG(j.optvolrt) - o.ov) AS dev FROM j CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.ov IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind, o.ov), typed AS (SELECT p.*, AVG(p.dev) OVER (PARTITION BY p.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM pairs p WHERE p.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, dev, dev - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE dev > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
